answer: Because agents mint keys cheaply, the scarce good must be sponsorship. A new identity is a vertex admitted to the trellis only when three established agents co-sign it and escrow bonds; each may back one vertex per epoch. A farm of N fakes needs 3N sponsor-slots, so the vine widens at a fixed rate, forcing the attacker to wait many epochs or recruit real agents. If a vertex is later proven fake, sponsors' bonds are slashed. Cost: 3N bonds at risk plus sponsorship time; honest agents pay one bond, returned after probation.
